categories.main_business_segments: Lianlian DigiTech primarily operates in digital payment services and value-added services. Its digital payment services include global payment, domestic payment, acquiring, foreign exchange, virtual card, and payment aggregation services. Value-added services encompass digital marketing, operation support, referral services, account and e-wallet solutions, and software development services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary technology platform that integrates payment, funds transfer, global payouts, smart foreign exchange processing, and smart risk management. It incorporates advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and big data analytics to enhance risk control, anti-fraud measures, customer service automation, and foreign exchange information services. The company maintains ISO 9001 and ISO 20000 certifications and follows strict R&D and operation management systems to ensure product quality and security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lianlian serves primarily small and medium-sized merchants and enterprises globally, especially those engaged in e-commerce and cross-border trade. Its customers include merchants selling goods on global and regional e-commerce platforms and enterprises seeking to streamline fund collection and payment processes. The company supports over 5.9 million customers cumulatively and focuses on B2B and services trade sectors, including industrial zones in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with services in over 100 countries and regions, supporting transactions in more than 130 currencies. Key geographic markets include mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, Singapore, the United States, the United Kingdom, Thailand, Luxembourg, Indonesia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South America. It holds 65 payment licenses worldwide, including all state-level money transmitter licenses in the U.S. and a virtual asset trading platform license in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lianlian operates primarily as a midstream digital payment solution provider, acting as a principal in payment services by facilitating pay-in, pay-out, foreign exchange, and payment aggregation. It serves as an intermediary enabling merchants and enterprises to process payments efficiently and securely, integrating upstream payment channels and downstream merchant and enterprise customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding its global licensing network and payment infrastructure, emphasizing compliance and regulatory adherence. It prioritizes technological innovation, including AI-driven risk control, blockchain integration, and the development of a new payment network combining Web2 and Web3 technologies. R&D investments target enhancing product capabilities, operational efficiency, and customer experience, with ongoing efforts to optimize organizational structure and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Lianlian generates revenue mainly through service fees from digital payment transactions, including fees based on transaction volumes and fixed fees per transaction. It also earns revenue from value-added services such as digital marketing, referral services, account and e-wallet services, and software development. Additionally, the company receives rental income from property leasing and interest income from customer accounts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lianlian positions itself as a leading Chinese digital payment solution provider with extensive global outreach and licensing coverage, distinguishing itself by holding all state-level money transmitter licenses in the U.S. and a broad global license portfolio. It competes in the cross-border payment and digital payment services industry, leveraging its proprietary technology and compliance framework to build competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Lianlian reported revenue of RMB 1.315 billion, a 27.9% increase year-on-year, with a gross profit margin of 51.9%. The total transaction payment volume (TPV) reached RMB 3.3 trillion, growing 64.7% year-on-year. Despite reporting a net loss of RMB 166.5 million, the adjusted profit excluding non-operating expenses was RMB 78.7 million, indicating a trend toward profitability. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 14.54 billion with equity of RMB 1.24 billion as of December 31, 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lianlian emphasizes making global commerce more efficient and accessible by providing a secure, reliable, and comprehensive digital payment ecosystem. Its unique value lies in its extensive global licensing network, advanced proprietary technology platform, and integration of AI and blockchain technologies. The company offers differentiated payment solutions tailored to diverse customer needs, ensuring compliance, operational stability, and enhanced user experience across global markets.
